facts.business: PC Jeweller Limited is engaged in the manufacturing, sale, and trading of gold and diamond jewellery, operating a retail chain in India and exporting to international markets.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company remains firmly on track to achieve a debt-free status in July-September 2026 quarter itself.
The Company is committed to strategically expanding its retail footprint to reach a broader customer base and enhance market presence.
The Company is dedicated to consistently delivering robust operational and financial performance in the upcoming periods, driving sustainable growth and creating value for its stakeholders.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis on: 1) Discounts of ₹513.65 crore to export customers in FY2019, with ₹183.16 crore approval pending; 2) Expected credit loss of ₹281.39 crore on outstanding export receivables as at March 31, 2026; 3) Inter-corporate loans and staff advances with no fresh loans granted; 4) Unspent CSR amounts for FY2020-21 and FY2021-22 not transferred to special accounts; 5) Delay in XBRL submission for Postal Ballot voting results by 1 day.

key_risks: High gold prices influencing consumer purchase behaviour and moderating purchase volumes
Dependence on exchange schemes for affordability
Softer global demand leading to decline in cut and polished diamond exports
Outstanding export receivables with expected credit loss provision of ₹281.39 crore
Pending regulatory approvals for export discounts (₹183.16 crore balance)
Unspent CSR amounts for prior years not transferred to special accounts
Execution risk in mining venture (PCJ Mining SARL in Chad)
Deleveraging risk despite significant progress in debt repayment
facts.related_party_note: Inter-corporate loans extended to subsidiaries and other body corporates comprise brought-forward balances from previous years. Luxury Products Trendsetter Private Limited repaid ₹3.50 crore during the year. Staff advances extended to permanent employees in normal course. Provision for impairment of loans made where required.
